statuses.implemented: Software for the requirement is complete; only acceptance in other evidence classes remains.
statuses.partial: Some software exists and named software gaps remain.
statuses.deferred: Out of the MVP by recorded policy.
statuses.blocked: Cannot progress without an external decision, resource or artifact.

note: Status is software state, not acceptance. Evidence lists source and test paths that implement or check the requirement; they are not passing results. Each gate names the next evidence class required. Refreshed 2026-10-11 at main 2560eead against upstream pin 13c9857598, with every entry re-read. At that pin there are source and browser test results, developer APK builds without the resident runtime (not distributable) and one partial emulator campaign on those builds (docs/verification.md, Emulator results at 2961bd9e, called round 8 below). Where an entry cites an emulator result it is that campaign or the round 7 campaign at the earlier pin 40dbe96bd1 (Emulator results at 6dcdde34), named as such. Both are class E on developer APKs and neither is evidence for a distributable build or a device. No hosted emulator job has been dispatched and no device result exists (docs/mvp-current-status.md, Current qualification evidence). Round 10 integration adds accessibility, native robustness, approval-notice recovery and strict-build changes after this evidence snapshot. References below to current source failures describe the recorded round 8 APKs; they are not results for the combined source. See the round 10 sections in docs/verification.md. Policy reconciled on 2026-10-12 from the owner answers: approval changes scope and next work only, not prior evidence.

requirements.title: Distinct branded home, app grid and assistant entry; independent package and storage identity
requirements.gate: E: LauncherLibrary, which has never run, and the HOME-role phase (SettingsRoles, LauncherHome) on a distributable launcher APK; then D on the selected phone
requirements.remaining: The All-apps drawer, search and landscape Home exist with browser tests against a stubbed bridge. On an emulator the HOME-role phase passed on developer APKs at the current pin (round 8: SettingsRoles and LauncherHome 3 of 3 on the final APKs with the original HOME holder read back; class E), and the launcher flavor keeps one live MainActivity when the role is granted. Favorites and order, exact component and profile identity and refresh on package change are implemented in source with Node and stubbed-bridge browser tests; LauncherLibraryInstrumentedTest has never run (MVP-53). No distributable build, image or phone has run any of it.

requirements.title: Standalone and HOME APKs from one source; offline shell; stock settings and recovery accessible
requirements.gate: B: four distribution APKs build at the current pin and pass scripts/verify-apks.mjs; then E: install both modes, open apps and return HOME repeatedly
requirements.remaining: No distribution APK build exists at the current pin (13c9857598): the strict build stops at the reviewed embedding host libraries, which are not in Git and which a person must supply, and it needs qualified speech assets that do not exist (MVP-39, MVP-23). Developer APKs without the resident runtime were built there (hosted Android foundation runs 38118499272 at c0b19147 and 38131665152 at f87850fa, and development machines); none is distributable. Both flavors of a developer build were installed on an emulator in round 8 and the default classes passed except BrowserFlow, which fails on its live-search method (class E). The Welcome dialog's local-apps entry is covered by a stubbed-bridge browser test; nothing has run on a device.

requirements.title: Owner-bound managed service sign-in and subscription for a local-only agent
requirements.gate: S: local-only service onboarding and subscription policy, then R/D authentication and latency
requirements.remaining: MVP-04/MVP-34: remove hosted-agent product paths, migrate credit UI to subscriptions, qualify owner-bound inference without a per-turn billing preflight.

requirements.title: Resident agent execution and powered-on scheduling with disclosed hosted text inference
requirements.gate: E then D: resident lifecycle, history, missed occurrences and no duplicate effects
requirements.remaining: MVP-21/MVP-38: qualify resident-only execution and cancellation; remove hosted-agent fallback and retain historical data without reconnecting it.

requirements.title: Pill, input, overlay and full assistant modes with keyboard and navigation continuity
requirements.gate: E: soft-keyboard resize, Back and HOME without keyboard obstruction on an installed APK; then D
requirements.remaining: Draft retention through every pre-dispatch failure is implemented with browser source evidence only (test/browser/chat-continuity.spec.ts). Emulator and device acceptance of resize, Back and HOME without keyboard obstruction remain: Shell, which has a soft-keyboard layout check, passed on both flavors of the developer APKs in round 8 (class E), and Assistant and Flow have no recorded run. Attaching the assistant surface to a running resident without restarting it is implemented in source with JVM and renderer contract tests; AssistantResidentReuseInstrumentedTest has never run (MVP-16).

requirements.title: Always-local native STT/TTS, dictation, interruptible voice assistant and AOSP listening
requirements.gate: S: native speech/turn integration, then E both ABIs and D audio/latency/listening
requirements.remaining: MVP-01/MVP-23/MVP-24/MVP-52: native Eliza llama.cpp/JNI, candidate benchmarks, Clef feasibility, distinct dictation and auto-submit conversation, barge-in and AOSP always-on acceptance are not implemented to the newly approved contract.

requirements.title: Daily overview with real agenda, attention items and briefs
requirements.gate: R: real provider agenda and digests with loading, empty, stale and error states; then D
requirements.remaining: Agenda comes from on-device calendars only, and schedules are digest-only. A missed occurrence is recorded once and never replaces the last brief. The Home cards name their source and when it was read, and the latest retained brief has its own card, with synthetic provider data only. Browser tests run from a digest result to that card with a stubbed agent and Android bridge; no real scheduled digest, native delivery or device calendar read is behind it (MVP-19).

requirements.title: AOSP-only Phone, SMS/MMS and Contacts
requirements.gate: S: AOSP capability gates and providers, then E roles and D real carrier endpoints
requirements.remaining: AOSP-only scope is not implemented: Contacts, Phone and SMS/MMS adapters and reliable role/capability gates; standalone must not expose them.

requirements.title: Inbox and calendar
requirements.gate: R: real Google OAuth grant, managed Cloud Gmail routes and a real mailbox; then D: a real synced calendar account on a phone
requirements.remaining: Gmail OAuth code exchange returns 401 (docs/cloud-production-validation.md), so no real mailbox has been used. Calendar shows only on-device calendars. On an emulator at the current pin the Calendar campaign passed on both flavors of the developer APKs (round 8, class E, fixture rows in the emulator's CalendarProvider): CalendarCrud, both CalendarAgentCrud methods, CalendarAvailability, CalendarTruncation, CalendarRange and CalendarFlow; InboxOperationJournal, MailAttachment and the inbox restart campaign passed there too. Use in email is implemented in source with synthetic agent and provider tests only (MVP-14). No real account, synced calendar or device has run any of it (MVP-12).

requirements.title: Browser, full permitted Photos, Cloud Maps, camera, Notes and Files
requirements.gate: S: Cloud Maps, full media and browser-policy integration, then R/E/D journeys
requirements.remaining: MVP-29/MVP-30/MVP-31: allow normal third-party cookies, eligible autofill, full permitted media, agent-controlled Eliza Cloud Maps and local read-aloud. Remove app-data import/export controls; preserve ordinary file operations.

requirements.title: Workflow library and run history
requirements.gate: E then D: interrupted-worker behavior on the resident runtime with real receipts
requirements.remaining: Phone workflows have manual triggers only, and the resident interrupted-worker case is unqualified on Android: the host digest restart check passed with a synthetic model at two earlier pins (last at 40dbe96b), is in no automated lane, and the process-death classes run only in hosted CI, which has never been dispatched. The native workflow campaign passed 14 of 14 cases on developer APKs on an emulator in round 8 (class E, synthetic reads and drafts).

requirements.title: Settings, subscription, local voice, native shade and confirmed reset
requirements.gate: S: reset/subscription/shade policy, then E/D persistence and recovery
requirements.remaining: MVP-33: implement reset without data resurrection, native shade/tiles, subscription status and local-only voice controls; no app-data migration/export.

requirements.title: Wallet excluded from MVP

requirements.remaining: Remove Wallet implementation/acceptance work from MVP; keep all production UI/agent/native routes disabled.

requirements.title: Pixel 10a Android 17 signed AOSP, always-on listener and recovery
requirements.gate: I and D: pinned Pixel 10a inputs, signing, listener, hardware and update/recovery
requirements.remaining: MVP-40/MVP-41/MVP-42/MVP-52: qualify exact source/vendor/kernel/signer inputs, AOSP listening, physical functions and OTA/recovery; policy approved, artifacts and acceptance still required.

requirements.title: Accessibility and resilience
requirements.gate: E: Accessibility, which fails on both flavors at the current source, and Rotation at the current pin; then D: TalkBack, large font, touch and keyboard, offline, killed process, rotation and repeated HOME navigation
requirements.remaining: A landscape Home layout exists with a browser test. On an emulator (developer APKs, class E) AccessibilityInstrumentedTest fails on both flavors at the current source (round 8): on standalone the last Home row is drawn under the floating composer at 200% text, and on launcher an accessibility click reaches no page control on that image's WebView. It had passed in round 7, before round 8 changed Home and the notifications panel. TextScale passed in round 8; Rotation passed in round 7 and was not repeated at the current pin. The all-views accessibility sweep and its fixes are a Chromium renderer check (test/browser/accessibility-sweep.spec.ts), not device acceptance (MVP-48). Physical TalkBack and accessibility acceptance remain.
